title: Baked White Fish with Roasted Root Vegetables
description: Herb-crusted baked white fish surrounded by caramelized carrots, beets and Brussels sprouts.
ingredients: 2x150 g white fish fillets (halibut or sole)
steps: Roast the root vegetables and Brussels sprouts until starting to caramelize.
Top the fish with a herb-breadcrumb mix, then add to the pan and roast until it flakes easily.
Finish with lemon juice and fresh herbs.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food fish recipe collection

notes: Rotate white fish varieties week to week — it is generally the lowest-mercury protein choice available.
